services.desc: A BUCKETLIST MUST! Paddle into the GLOWING waterway of dinoflagellates in glass bottom kayaks! See the plankton glow around your kayak. A nature phenomenon that only happens a few months a year! Kayak through the Thousand Islands of Cocoa Beach, Florida amongst the Bioluminescence GLOW! Only available in the summer months! Come and see Florida’s beautiful wildlife up close with a sunset kayak tour through the bioluminescent waters of the mangrove tunnels! quotes.author: Ellie M.
quotes.text: If you're looking for a fun weekend activity check out Cocoa Kayaking! Family friendly and so much fun. Guides are knowledgeable of the local eco system and it's so peaceful out on the water. I took my daughter on the Bioluminescence tour and we loved it! Cocoa Kayaking makes it extra fun by providing glowsticks and water shooters. Well definitely be back soon as we had so much fun!

quotes.author: Justin F.
quotes.text: Had a blast doing the wild life refuge with Cocoa Kayaking. Friendly staff, lots of animals and a great time on the water. Highly recommend for anyone looking to get out of the house and see some real Florida backcountry wildlife such as dolphins, manatees, birds, and the occasional gator if you're lucky. Will be back again, thanks for the great trip!

quotes.author: Tracy R.
quotes.text: We had such a great time, we had people new to kayaking and those with more experience and everyone seemed to have an equally great time. The tour was informational, relaxing and fun and the sunset was stunning but those glowing little jellyfish made you marvel at the beauty of nature. Everyone agreed it was money well spent and we'll do it again.

quotes.author: Amber S.
quotes.text: James was a friendly and laid back tour guide that took time with us as beginners and pointed out all the neat things to see during the tour. We had a great experience seeing manatees, mangrove crabs, birds, and we got some fun pictures along the way. The company was very helpful with updates and was easy to book and communicate with.
